sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive recent run. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, while visitors Alsager Town are struggling near the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town as they chase Sandbach's lead with 20 points. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two mid-table contenders—Bridgnorth bounced back from a loss with a win, while Eccleshall are winless in their last game. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, welcome Wednesfield Community to a derby-style clash; Casuals have won their last match while Wednesfield are inconsistent. Bilston Town (17 points, fifth) travel to Foley Meir in a fixture between two sides in good recent form. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a meeting of two middle-table teams, with Market Drayton's recent record mixed. Cheadle Heath Nomads' away trip to Telford Town pits two of the division's lowest scorers against each other—both struggling teams near the bottom. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between sides fighting relegation fears, while Shawbury United welcome Barnton; Shawbury's recent form has been dire with five consecutive losses before a win. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, with the visitors having an appalling record of no wins from seven games and minus-23 goal difference—among the division's poorest performers.
